sections.content: Font properties control text: font-family (stack fallbacks), font-size (prefer rem over px), font-weight, line-height, letter-spacing, text-align.
System font stacks load instantly; web fonts via @font-face or Google Fonts need font-display: swap to avoid invisible text.
Key points: 1rem = 16px default, line-height ~1.5-1.7 for body text, and never set font-size below 16px on inputs (iOS zooms).
